assumption: Performance frequency is implementation-dependent Hz; all guest counter APIs must use the same units and origin.
basis: Microsoft NtQueryPerformanceCounter documentation; native four-profile calibration measured24000000Hz, unlike the unverified10MHz guess; existing HLE counter uses elapsed nanoseconds and1000000000Hz.
dependent-result: Clock unit and public/native/shared-data parity design
stress-test: Mix native/public counter values; query Shared QpcFrequency; compare monotonic deltas across calls and threads.
falsification-probe: Counter/frequency pairs use different scale or origin; native/public frequencies disagree; DLL bypass sees zero/stale shared frequency.
status-detail: Native Rust adapter and installed NT/public helpers passed direct host frequency/epoch brackets; shared-data frequency matches. Built-in elapsed1GHz preserved.

assumption: Counter publication precedes optional frequency validation/store; ULONG alignment4 applies on all measured profiles.
basis: Four completed250-case matrices preserve counter bytes on optional output failure and accept offset4 while rejecting offsets1..3.
dependent-result: Checked output order, alias and fault policy
stress-test: Read-only/no-access/guard/cross-page outputs, aliases offsets0..12, invalid pointers and both pointer widths.
falsification-probe: Independent producer or shared replay contradicts status, guard visitation or retained counter bytes.

assumption: Writable guard stores consume one guard; read-only guard failures deny without consuming it.
basis: All four native profiles: guardRW returns80000001/p3=4; guardRO returnsC0000005/p4=102. Existing write_guard_result models this distinction.
stress-test: Counter guard versus frequency guard; early invalid counter prevents frequency visitation.
falsification-probe: Matched controls or replay leave a consumed guard armed or consume a read-only guard.

assumption: The observed ordinary program boundary represents the next required native service.
basis: Combined-upstream owning archive and unchanged observer still reach NtQueryPerformanceCounter0x31/RVA1350 at168227turns; threeCRTprograms share the boundary.
stress-test: Combined AArch64 upstream source and final owning archive may change the boundary.
falsification-probe: Same observer on the integrated archive stops earlier or at another service.
status-detail: Counter service passed native/public/helper gates; ordinary C++ and extended observer now reach class35. Original1M observer budget exhaustion retained.

assumption: Replay normalizes runtime clock samples without weakening status, guard or caller-byte checks.
basis: Captured test-only clock input lies within the independently sampled native before/after bracket and matches every visible counter byte. Successful frequency aliases overwrite only their8-byte captured frequency span. Failed counter stores keep exact canaries.
stress-test: Counter/frequency aliases0/4/8/12, unchanged failed stores, mismatched time brackets, cross-page faults and repeated guards.
falsification-probe: A replay mismatch, impossible recovered sample or counter-store/order fault survives the exact byte comparison.
